property_summary: After a single ETH deposit via receive() then a sendMoney() call, in the reference contract depositsCount is 1 (because the increment in receive() executes before sendMoney() is called), but in the mutant it is 0 (because receive() resets it to 0 before sendMoney() runs).
change_summary: Replace depositsCount++ with depositsCount = 0 in the receive function
